summary: Fetch release-delivery snapshots from the verified local source and clean abandoned Git transfer packs under the delivery lock.

schema.detail: No persistent delivery-state or database schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule changes; trusted commit ancestry and monotonic build protections remain enforced.

compatibility.detail: Delivery transfers a local snapshot only after a bounded ls-remote request proves publication at the approved origin. Branch snapshots must equal the published tip; pinned commits may be locally provable ancestors of published tips. Unavailable proof or unresolvable source snapshot skips all delivery, including cached installation. Snapshot outcomes include SHA, ref and commit time.

downtime.detail: No live scheduler activation or app installation is performed by this source change.

manual.detail: Deployment owners must adopt the reviewed worker source and ensure the configured local source repository's origin remote-tracking ref is refreshed. Delivery no longer refreshes that ref over the network.

recovery.detail: Transfers keep complete packs in isolated object directories, link packs before their indexes and update FETCH_HEAD atomically only after successful promotion. Failure preserves the prior FETCH_HEAD, kills and reaps the transfer group, then deletes only its owned directory. Shared temporary packs require age over one hour and lsof proof of no live users; missing lsof, warnings or errors retain them. Parent SIGTERM is blocked until the handler owns the spawned group; the child restores its original mask before exec. Cached retries require both a resolvable snapshot and successful publication proof.
